title: Steer selects due jobs from cached next_due_at
query: Steer has three configured jobs in scheduler state. One next_due_at is yesterday, one is tomorrow, and one has no state after a config version bump. What should steer-update do?
reference_points: Selects jobs by comparing now to cached next_due_at
Initializes or migrates state when config_version changed
Does not mutate farplane/steer.config.json during a normal run
Updates next_due_at after a job runs

title: Steer writes dated reports
query: A Steer daily_report job runs successfully. Where should the report go and how should consumers find the newest one?
reference_points: Writes a date-stamped report for the job
Does not use latest.md as the canonical report
Keeps mutable report pointers out of tracked config

title: Steer weekly scrum requires goals delta gates
query: The weekly steering review wants to change the north star and quarterly goal. What gates apply?
reference_points: Writes the report before goals mutation
Requires approval for north-star or quarterly changes
Routes executable changes to tickets or Goal Advisor handoffs
Labels missing or stale evidence as source gaps
